uncited: - **Time Complexity**: Scale-space computation is $O(n \cdot V \cdot |\mathcal{N}|)$ where $V$ is number of voxels and $|\mathcal{N}|$ is stencil size.
- **Memory Complexity**: Requires storing the scale space $L$ for all iterations if backprojection is done offline, or just the current layer if streaming.

The claim oversimplifies the structure and ignores the scale dimension and potential resolution changes described in the text.
